rationale: The two most recent candles show a clear momentum breakdown: the penultimate bar made a new low at $33.45 and the current bar has a high of only $33.73 before closing at $33.51, placing price back below both the 5-min VWAP ($33.56) and the 9-EMA ($33.64) — the same two levels that justified the entry. The staircase of higher highs and higher lows that formed the entry thesis has been violated, and with session VWAP at $35.84 more than 7% above current price, the structural downtrend pressure dominates; holding for a $0.69 remaining gain against a backdrop of deteriorating short-term structure is not justified.
